text:
Russian road signage, right-hand traffic and dense trolleybus wiring point to a Russian city; the broad, tree-lined avenue and industrial skyline suggest Siberia. My best guess is Novosibirsk.

Traditional Chinese signage, right-hand traffic and scooter-heavy streets point strongly to Taiwan. The palm-lined coastal setting with mountains close behind the city is most consistent with Hualien on Taiwan’s east coast.

The birch and pine vegetation, flat northern landscape, and timber buildings point to Scandinavia, while the road layout and bridge fit Finland particularly well. My best guess is a small public park or riverside area near Rovaniemi.
